events.question: What personal credit cards does Rho-Bank offer for everyday purchases, and what are their cash back rates and annual fees?

facts_found: Rho-Bank personal cash-back cards are Bronze Rewards, Silver Rewards, Gold Rewards, Platinum Rewards, Diamond Elite, and Crypto-Cash Back; EcoCard is the only true points-based personal card (sustainability points). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases with a $0.00 annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_002]
Bronze Rewards Card requires a minimum credit score of 640 and has a $0.00 annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_001]
Silver Rewards Card earns 4.0% back only on eligible travel and software purchases; purchases outside those top categories earn 1.0% back. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]
Silver Rewards Card has a $0.00 annual fee and a minimum credit score of 680. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on all purchases with a $0.00 annual fee, but requires an active Rho-Bank+ premium subscription and a minimum credit score of 720. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases and has a $200.00 annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% on all categories without rotating caps, and offers a $150.00 annual fee rebate if a monthly spend threshold of $7,500.00 is met. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007]

The Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate requires meeting the monthly spend threshold in EVERY month of the cardmember year; one missed month forfeits the rebate for that year. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_010]
Diamond Elite Card earns 5.0% cash back on all eligible purchases. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]

Diamond Elite Card has a standard annual fee of $495.00; the fee is waived and a $5,000 statement credit is granted if $50,000 is spent within the invitation promo period. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_006]
Diamond Elite Card is invitation-only and generally requires a credit score of at least 780 to be considered. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_001]
Crypto-Cash Back earns 2.0% on eligible spend with a $75.00 annual fee; crypto redemption minimum is $30 with a 1.25% conversion fee. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_008]
Crypto-Cash Back requires a minimum credit score of 660. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_009]
EcoCard earns 5 sustainability points per dollar at qualifying green merchants and 1 point per dollar on other purchases; points redeem at $0.01 each. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_002]
EcoCard has a $50.00 annual fee and no minimum credit score requirement. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_001]

EcoCard's higher green rate excludes Target, Walmart, Amazon, and ThredUp (these earn the standard 1 point/$), and EV charging qualifies only at Tesla Supercharger, ChargePoint, or EVgo. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_004]

Rewards categories include Groceries, Dining, Utilities (electric/gas/water/internet bills), and Transportation; each card has its own bonus categories and non-bonus purchases earn the card's default rate. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]
Cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest, and cash-equivalent transactions do not earn rewards on the Platinum Rewards Card. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
All credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored) to the nearest whole number. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

Redemption minimums: Gold and Platinum Rewards Cards require $15; Diamond Elite requires at least 5; Crypto-Cash Back requires $30 to redeem to crypto; EcoCard requires 3,000 points. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
The only personal no-annual-fee downgrade option is the Bronze Rewards Card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008]

open_questions: No personal Rho-Bank card was found that offers an elevated bonus rate specifically on groceries, dining, or gas-station fuel; these everyday categories earn each card's base/flat rate. (Silver's 4% bonus is travel/software only.)

The knowledge base does not state any annual or quarterly dollar cap on cash back earnings for the personal cards (Platinum is explicitly described as having no rotating caps; no explicit statement of a hard annual earning ceiling was found for the others).
Exact minimum credit score / eligibility terms for the personal Platinum Rewards Card were not located in the retrieved documents (only the business Platinum card's 765 threshold appeared).
Bronze Rewards Card and Silver Rewards Card redemption minimums were not explicitly stated in the retrieved documents.
